name: Exterior Porch Floor Wood RP Prep
intent: Wood RP prep. Scuff sand (sound/worn), scrape+feather (failing/peeling), wood fill, clean.
doctrine: Wood RP prep. Scuff sand 100 SF/hr for GOOD (sound/worn). Scrape 50 SF/hr + feather 70 SF/hr for FAIR/POOR (failing/peeling). Wood slower than concrete scraping due to T&G joints. Condition modifier on scrape/feather. Wood fill from manual LF capture.
